title: The Orbit of Kepler Reach
author: Xanthe Delacroix
blurb: Mirabel Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
